## Publication Information

**Date:** 1883-5

**Genre:** Non-fiction: edited drama

**Publisher:** London: National Society’s Depository, Broad Sanctuary, Westminster.

**Notes:** Contains <i>Henry IV</i> parts I and II, <i>Henry V, Richard II </i>and <i>Julius Caesar.</i>
